text: OK, I solved it, or rather, figured out a workaround. If my head is giving the low power signal some problems, what if I gave the signal an easier path? So if I am touching both HAs at the same time while pressing a button on either, it works flawlessly; a button press on one HA is registered on the other. My arms/body provide a seemingly easier conduit for the signal. Who woulda thunk?!

context: r/HearingAids 板块, 我方身份=OTC助听器代工厂主(u/luogangan), 已发4篇工厂视角科普帖建立信誉 | 他在我的蓝牙帖下补充了一个自测出来的LE Audio通话缺陷
text: I've been working on an issue where people on phone calls can't hear me clearly. They say my voice is very quiet. I have Starkey Omega AI 24 mRICs, Google Pixel 10 Pro. The culprit is LE Audio. On a phone call with LE Audio enabled and using the mic on the phone, the phone's mic volume is lowered. I used an echo test phone number. With LE Audio enabled it was difficult to hear what I was saying. When I disabled it, which forces bluetooth classic, my voice was loud and clear. So while they work great for audio coming in, they kinda suck at actually using the phone. I'll be contacting the android Accessibility team. Also there's a tiny dongle, FlooGoo FMA120 on Amazon. It has the bluetooth radio needed for hearing aids with LE Audio. I have one. It works.

context: r/HearingAids 板块, 我方身份=OTC助听器代工厂主(u/luogangan), 已发4篇工厂视角科普帖建立信誉。任务: 判断该帖是否值得评论, 以及评论该走什么打法 | 她不是求助, 是主动分享闭合耳塞对耳鸣的效果
text: I just had my 2 week follow up with my audiologist. They shortened the wire on my right ear (I think maybe a little too short, dang it) and replaced the open domes with a closed dome that looks kinda flat maybe a tulip but didn't look like the one on the resound website. She said shes gotten a lot of positive feedback back on them and thinks they might be more helpful for my tinnitus. She calibrated the aids to make up for closed domes. And I think they are working! Last night my left ear had no ringing. It's not permanent, as I took mine out to wash my car and the ringing is now super loud. But after having them in all day yesterday the ringing was minimal. Just an fyi if people are still struggling with tinnitus.
